notes.title: BOMBFEST is OUT!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/e8f439b3d32ffec6a38507621a08494f63503848.png[/img]
[h1]It's Go Time[/h1]
As of right now, [b]BOMBFEST is live on Steam![/b] Buy a copy today, and enjoy some chaotic, multiplayer fun!

To help celebrate the launch of this 4-year project, we've created a couple of commercials to promote the game. Many talented people came together to make these possible. Check them out below!

[url=https://youtu.be/VNCb2JTRWcQ][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/e6790f883badf15795b1d0c2f2a07e3029bbaf56.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/sT9xpS9x7PY][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/d1fbaccd0e8dca8715ac474c2fa80035dcbd7222.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: 1 Week Until Release!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/1cb9af8a29ca5b7399086198f40b20644763f289.png[/img]
[h1]Here It Comes![/h1]
BOMBFEST will be here in 7 days! In the meantime, our team is working our butts off to make sure you get the best game we can offer on launch. We're crushing bugs, scheduling social media, and sleeping occasionally!
[h1]Support The Game![/h1]
Excited to play? Want to help us out? Consider spreading the word and [b]wishlisting us[/b]! Wishlists help us climb the ranks of Steams goofy algorithm, so it means a lot to show your support this way.

notes.title: BOMBFEST Launches January 31st!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/c40106a1d91b47e6f0cc5e9211e3e0bb80b8f12b.jpg[/img]

[h1]That's right, folks![/h1]
After years of development and months of certification, we are officially clear for launch! In 21 days, you can pick up BOMBFEST on Steam and toss bombs at your friends to your heart's content.

[h1]Don't Forget To Wishlist![/h1]
Wishlisting helps us out immensely, so if you're even casually interested in the game, consider supporting your local indie developers by [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/729640/BOMBFEST/]adding BOMBFEST to your Steam Wishlist![/url]

notes.title: BOMBFEST 1.01 Update!
notes.content:
We've got an update for you today, friends! Plenty of bug fixes to improve your experience. Check out the changes below:

[list]
[*] AI may no longer earn achievements for you
[*] Fixed unlocking Ice Bomb twice
[*] Fixed Cotton Swap not OHKOing when players are at max damage
[*] Fixed Setup Menu overlapping itself when first opened
[/list]

Let us know what you think, and good luck with those achievements!

notes.title: BOMBFEST Now Features Achievements!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30910250/f443d342d1aa4a5164ec5a5d08980ff733460527.png[/img]
[h1]Check It New Achievements![/h1]
Try your hand at an array of achievable-ments! With 34 challenges to try, there's something for everyone.

Have fun, and good luck on that Living Room one!
